<script type="text/javascript">
// Function to modify the viewport meta tag for zoom control
function fixViewport() {
    // Find the viewport meta tag
    var meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]');

    // If the meta tag exists
    if (meta) {
        // Parse the content of the viewport meta tag
        var content = meta.getAttribute('content');
        
        // Replace disallowed scaling settings if they exist
        content = content.replace(/user-scalable\s*=\s*no/i, 'user-scalable=yes');
        content = content.replace(/maximum-scale\s*=\s*[\d\.]+/i, 'maximum-scale=5.0');
        
        // Update the viewport meta tag's content attribute
        meta.setAttribute('content', content);
    } else {
        // If no viewport meta tag exists, create one with proper settings
        meta = document.createElement('meta');
        meta.name = 'viewport';
        meta.content = 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1, user-scalable=yes, maximum-scale=5.0';
        document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(meta);
    }
}

// Run the function when the document loads
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixViewport);
</script>

        /* Heading alignment utilities */
        .wppro-ada-item--align-left   { text-align: left; }
        .wppro-ada-item--align-center { text-align: center; }
        .wppro-ada-item--align-right  { text-align: right; }
        .wppro-ada-card {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            isolation: isolate;
        }

        /* Focus indicator */
        .wppro-ada-card--expandable:focus {
            outline: 3px solid #005fcc;
            outline-offset: 3px;
            z-index: 9999 !important;
            position: relative;
        }

        .wppro-ada-card__bg {
            position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
        }
        .wppro-ada-card__inner {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: var(--wppro-gap, .75rem);
            width: 100%;
            flex: 1;
            --wppro-h-align: flex-start;
            --wppro-v-align: flex-start;
            align-items: var(--wppro-h-align);
            justify-content: var(--wppro-v-align);
        }
        .wppro-ada-card__inner--h-left   { --wppro-h-align: flex-start; }
        .wppro-ada-card__inner--h-center { --wppro-h-align: center; }
        .wppro-ada-card__inner--h-right  { --wppro-h-align: flex-end; }
        .wppro-ada-card__inner--v-top    { --wppro-v-align: flex-start; }
        .wppro-ada-card__inner--v-middle { --wppro-v-align: center; }
        .wppro-ada-card__inner--v-bottom { --wppro-v-align: flex-end; }

        .wppro-ada-card__inner > .wppro-ada-item {
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            justify-content: var(--wppro-h-align);
        }
        .wppro-ada-item--align-left   { justify-content:flex-start !important; }
        .wppro-ada-item--align-center { justify-content:center !important; }
        .wppro-ada-item--align-right  { justify-content:flex-end !important; }

        /* Hidden elements - RELATIVE by default for smooth animation */
        .wppro-ada-item--hidden {
            position: relative;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            max-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease-in-out, max-height 0.5s ease-in-out;
        }

        /* Add this class AFTER collapse animation finishes */
        .wppro-ada-item--hidden.fully-collapsed {
            position: absolute !important;
        }

        /* Expanded state */
        .wppro-ada-card--expandable:hover .wppro-ada-item--hidden,
        .wppro-ada-card--expandable.is-expanded .wppro-ada-item--hidden {
            position: relative !important;
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
            max-height: 2000px;
        }

        /* Wrapper div (when custom class applied) - FULL WIDTH & CENTERED */
        .wppro-ada-card > div:has(.wppro-ada-card__expand-btn) {
            visibility: hidden;
            opacity: 0;
            height: 0;
            margin: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease-out, height 0.2s ease-out, margin 0.2s ease-out;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 100%;
            text-align: center;
        }

        /* Expand button - collapses to zero height when hidden */
        .wppro-ada-card__expand-btn,
        .wppro-ada-card > div > .wppro-ada-card__expand-btn {
            visibility: hidden;
            opacity: 0;
            height: 0;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            background: #005fcc;
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease-out, height 0.2s ease-out, margin 0.2s ease-out;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 10;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        /* When button is NOT wrapped (no custom class) - center it */
        .wppro-ada-card > .wppro-ada-card__expand-btn {
            align-self: center;
            width: auto;
        }

        /* Show button (unwrapped) when card has keyboard focus */
        .wppro-ada-card--expandable:focus:not(:hover) .wppro-ada-card__expand-btn {
            visibility: visible;
            opacity: 1;
            height: auto;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        /* Show wrapper div (wrapped version) when card has keyboard focus */
        .wppro-ada-card--expandable:focus:not(:hover) > div:has(.wppro-ada-card__expand-btn) {
            visibility: visible;
            opacity: 1;
            height: auto;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        /* NEW: keep expand/collapse button visible while expanded,
           even after focus moves into the revealed content */
        .wppro-ada-card--expandable.is-expanded .wppro-ada-card__expand-btn,
        .wppro-ada-card--expandable.is-expanded > div:has(.wppro-ada-card__expand-btn) {
            visibility: visible;
            opacity: 1;
            height: auto;
            margin-top: 1rem;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        /* Touch devices */
        @media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
            .wppro-ada-card--expandable .wppro-ada-card__expand-btn,
            .wppro-ada-card--expandable > div:has(.wppro-ada-card__expand-btn) {
                visibility: visible;
                opacity: 1;
                height: auto;
                margin-top: 1rem;
            }

            .wppro-ada-card--expandable .wppro-ada-card__expand-btn {
                pointer-events: auto;
            }
        }

        /* Heading */
        .wppro-ada-heading {
            margin:0; line-height:1.25;
            display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5em; flex-wrap:nowrap;
        }
        .wppro-ada-heading--ivalign-top    { align-items:flex-start; }
        .wppro-ada-heading--ivalign-middle { align-items:center; }
        .wppro-ada-heading--ivalign-bottom { align-items:flex-end; }
        .wppro-ada-heading__icon  { display:inline-flex; flex:0 0 auto; line-height:0; }
        .wppro-ada-heading__label { display:inline-block; flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; }

        /* Button/Link */
        .wppro-ada-btn {
            display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5em; flex-wrap:nowrap;
            text-decoration:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
            padding:.6rem 1rem; border-radius:.375rem; line-height:1.2; transition:all .15s;
        }
        .wppro-ada-btn--ivalign-top    { align-items:flex-start; }

        .wppro-ada-btn--link      { background:transparent!important; padding:0; border-radius:0; text-decoration:underline; }

        .wppro-ada-btn i { line-height:0; }

            .wppro-ada-card{
                margin-bottom:10px;

				<sr7-module data-alias="lac-home-12" data-id="11" id="SR7_11_1" class="rs-ov-hidden" data-version="6.8.1">
					<sr7-adjuster></sr7-adjuster>
					<sr7-content>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-273" data-key="273">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-273-2" class="sr7-layer">Epilepsy Awareness Month</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-273-3" class="sr7-layer">LA County proclaimed November 2026 as “Epilepsy Awareness Month.” For information and resources, click below. <br />
<br />
<a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-1 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://www.cdc.gov/epilepsy/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View information and resources on Epilepsy from CDC " >Learn more</a></sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-272" data-key="272">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-272-2" class="sr7-layer">National Family Caregivers Month</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-272-3" class="sr7-layer">LA County proclaimed November 2026 as “National Family Caregivers Month.” For information to get connected with local support, respite care, and resources, click below. <br />
<br />
<a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-1 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://ad.lacounty.gov/services/older-adult-services/fcsp/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View More about Family Caregiver Support Program " >Learn more</a><br />
</sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-268" data-key="268">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-268-2" class="sr7-layer">New Resource Hub to Stay Informed</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-268-3" class="sr7-layer">LA County has a new resource hub to help you stay informed of federal and state budget cuts, eligibility changes, deadlines and news. Click below to stay informed. <br><br />
<a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-3 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://lacounty.gov/impacts/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="CLICK HERE">CLICK HERE</a><br />
</sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-267" data-key="267">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-267-2" class="sr7-layer">Reclaiming Home: Black Altadena Rebuilds</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-267-3" class="sr7-layer">Click below to watch documentary that follows four families as Altadena rebuilds.<br><br />
<a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-1 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://lacounty.gov/2026/07/31/reclaiming-home-black-altadena-rebuilds/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="CLICK HERE" >CLICK HERE</a><br />
</sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-251" data-key="251">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-251-2" class="sr7-layer">Express Lane for Rebuilding</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-251-3" class="sr7-layer">LA County is streamlining the process for rebuilding after the wildfires, residents can move into the express lane on their rebuilding journey by using several key tools. For information, click below.<br><br> <a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-1 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://recovery.lacounty.gov/express-lane-for-rebuilding/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View More about Express Lanes for Rebuilding">View More about Express Lanes for Rebuilding</a><br />
</sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-265" data-key="265">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-265-2" class="sr7-layer">LA County Sexual Abuse & Exploitation Reporting Line<br />
</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-265-3" class="sr7-layer">A confidential 24/7 hotline for reporting suspected sexual abuse or exploitation involving LA County facilities or County personnel.<br />
<br />
<a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-1 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://211la.org/report-sexualabuse" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="View More about the 211 Child Sexual Abuse Hotline" >Learn more</a></sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-252" data-key="252">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-252-2" class="sr7-layer">Report fraud to LA County</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-252-3" class="sr7-layer">Click the link bleow  or call (844) 901-0001 to provide information or evidence of improper solicitations, false childhood sexual assault claims (including AB 218), or other false claims against the County of Los Angeles. <br><br><br />
<a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-3 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://iddweb.isd.lacounty.gov/AuditorOCI/AB218" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Learn More about Reporting Fraud in LA County">Learn more about Reporting Fraud</a><br />
</sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-246" data-key="246">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-246-2" class="sr7-layer">LA County Wildfire Recovery Resources</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-246-3" class="sr7-layer">Residents impacted by the multiple wildfires in LA County can view preliminary maps showing damage assessments and other recovery resources by visiting recovery.lacounty.gov. <br><br><a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-1 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://recovery.lacounty.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Learn More about Resources">Learn more about resources</a><br />
</sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>
						<sr7-slide id="SR7_11_1-247" data-key="247">
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-247-2" class="sr7-layer">Recursos de Recuperación por Incendios Forestales del Condado de Los Angeles</sr7-txt>
							<sr7-txt id="SR7_11_1-247-3" class="sr7-layer">Los residentes afectados por los múltiples incendios forestales en el Condado de Los Angeles pueden ver mapas preliminares que muestran las evaluaciones de daños y otros recursos de recuperación visitando recovery.lacounty.gov.<br><br><a class="grve-btn grve-btn-extrasmall grve-round grve-bg-primary-1 grve-bg-hover-black" href="https://recovery.lacounty.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="SABER MÁS">SABER MÁS</a><br />
</sr7-txt>
						</sr7-slide>

        (function() {
            'use strict';

            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                const expandableCards = document.querySelectorAll('.wppro-ada-card--expandable');

                expandableCards.forEach(function(card) {
                    const btn = card.querySelector('.wppro-ada-card__expand-btn');
                    if (!btn) return;

                    const expandLabel   = btn.dataset.expandLabel || 'Show more details';
                    const collapseLabel = btn.dataset.collapseLabel || 'Show less details';
                    const hiddenItems   = card.querySelectorAll('.wppro-ada-item--hidden');

                    let collapseTimeout = null;

                    // --- Helpers for collapse animation --------------------------------

                    function addFullyCollapsed() {
                        if (collapseTimeout) {
                            clearTimeout(collapseTimeout);
                        }
                        collapseTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                            if (!card.classList.contains('is-expanded') && !card.matches(':hover')) {
                                hiddenItems.forEach(function(item) {
                                    const styles = window.getComputedStyle(item);
                                    if (styles.opacity === '0' || parseFloat(styles.opacity) < 0.1) {
                                        item.classList.add('fully-collapsed');
                                    }
                                });
                            }
                            collapseTimeout = null;
                        }, 500); // keep in sync with CSS transition
                    }

                    function removeFullyCollapsed() {
                        if (collapseTimeout) {
                            clearTimeout(collapseTimeout);
                            collapseTimeout = null;
                        }
                        hiddenItems.forEach(function(item) {
                            item.classList.remove('fully-collapsed');
                        });
                    }

                    // --- Focus management for hidden content ---------------------------

                    function getHiddenFocusables() {
                        const selector = [
                            'a[href]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
                            'button:not([disabled]):not([tabindex="-1"])',
                            'input:not([disabled]):not([tabindex="-1"])',
                            'select:not([disabled]):not([tabindex="-1"])',
                            'textarea:not([disabled]):not([tabindex="-1"])',
                            '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])'
                        ].join(',');

                        const result = [];
                        hiddenItems.forEach(function(item) {
                            const candidates = item.querySelectorAll(selector);
                            Array.prototype.forEach.call(candidates, function(el) {
                                if (el.offsetParent !== null) {
                                    result.push(el);
                                }
                            });
                        });
                        return result;
                    }

                    // Make hidden content tabbable or not, and restore original tabindex when needed
                    function setHiddenTabbable(allowTab) {
                        const focusables = getHiddenFocusables();

                        focusables.forEach(function(el) {
                            if (allowTab) {
                                // restore original tabindex (if any)
                                const orig = el.getAttribute('data-wppro-orig-tabindex');
                                if (orig === 'none') {
                                    el.removeAttribute('tabindex');
                                } else if (orig !== null) {
                                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', orig);
                                }
                                el.removeAttribute('data-wppro-orig-tabindex');
                            } else {
                                // collapsing: store existing tabindex (or 'none') then force -1
                                if (!el.hasAttribute('data-wppro-orig-tabindex')) {
                                    if (el.hasAttribute('tabindex')) {
                                        el.setAttribute('data-wppro-orig-tabindex', el.getAttribute('tabindex'));
                                    } else {
                                        el.setAttribute('data-wppro-orig-tabindex', 'none');
                                    }
                                }
                                el.tabIndex = -1;
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    // --- Initial state -------------------------------------------------

                    // Collapsed by default
                    addFullyCollapsed();
                    setHiddenTabbable(false);

                    // Card is the main keyboard trigger
                    card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                    card.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                    card.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    card.setAttribute('aria-label', expandLabel);

                    // Expand/collapse button starts as visual-only
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    btn.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

                    function updateButtonText(isExpanded) {
                        const textSpan = btn.querySelector('.wppro-ada-card__expand-text');
                        if (textSpan) {
                            textSpan.textContent = isExpanded ? collapseLabel : expandLabel;
                        }
                    }

                    // --- Core expand/collapse logic -----------------------------------

                    /**
                     * Set expanded/collapsed state
                     * @param {boolean} isExpanded
                     * @param {Object} opts
                     *   opts.focusContent -> if true and expanding, move focus into content
                     *   opts.focusCard    -> if true and collapsing, move focus back to card
                     */
                    function setExpanded(isExpanded, opts) {
                        opts = opts || {};

                        card.classList.toggle('is-expanded', isExpanded);
                        card.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isExpanded));
                        card.setAttribute('aria-label', isExpanded ? collapseLabel : expandLabel);

                        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isExpanded));

                        if (isExpanded) {
                            removeFullyCollapsed();
                            setHiddenTabbable(true);

                            // button becomes a real close control
                            btn.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
                            btn.tabIndex = 0;
                        } else {
                            setHiddenTabbable(false);
                            addFullyCollapsed();

                            // button back to visual-only
                            btn.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                            btn.tabIndex = -1;
                        }

                        if (!isExpanded && opts.focusCard) {

                        }

                        if (isExpanded && opts.focusContent) {
                            const focusables = getHiddenFocusables();
                            if (focusables.length) {
                                focusables[0].focus();
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    function toggleFromCard(isKeyboard) {
                        const isExpanded = card.classList.contains('is-expanded');
                        const newState   = !isExpanded;
                        setExpanded(newState, {
                            focusCard: !newState && isKeyboard,
                            focusContent: newState && isKeyboard
                        });

                    // Keyboard interaction on the card itself
                    card.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                        const key = e.key || e.code;

                        // Enter/Space → toggle only when the card itself has focus

                            toggleFromCard(true);
                            return;
                        }

                        // Escape closes from anywhere inside the card
                        if (key === 'Escape' || key === 'Esc') {
                            if (card.classList.contains('is-expanded')) {
                                e.preventDefault();
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                setExpanded(false, { focusCard: true });
                            }
                        }
                    });

                    card.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                        if (e.target.closest('a, button:not(.wppro-ada-card__expand-btn), input, select, textarea')) {
                            return;
                        }
                        const isExpanded = card.classList.contains('is-expanded');
                        setExpanded(!isExpanded, {
                            focusCard: false,
                            focusContent: false
                        });
                    });

                    // Clicking the expand/collapse button itself (when visible)
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        const isExpanded = card.classList.contains('is-expanded');

                            focusContent: !isExpanded

                            !card.contains(document.activeElement)) {
                            addFullyCollapsed();
                        }
                    });
                });
            });
